article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Jackson McAndrew's 19 points in the first half helped Creighton defeat Le Moyne 83-55 on Thursday. McAndrew added five rebounds for the Bluejays (2-0). Wes Enis scored 16 points and added three steals. Oswin Erhunmwunse finished with 10 points. Trevor Roe led the Dolphins (0-2) with 12 points, seven rebounds and three steals. Ty Francis added nine points for Le Moyne. Leandro Gysel finished with eight points and six assists. McAndrew helped put the Bluejays up 54-17 at the break. Creighton extended its lead to 75-40 during the second half, fueled by an 11-0 scoring run. Enis scored a team-high eight points in the second half. Up next Creighton's next game is Tuesday against Kansas State on the road, and Le Moyne hosts Elmira on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
